name: godot-runtime-verify
description: Verify a built Godot 2D or 3D scene at runtime: run it, read the debugger output, classify errors against a Godot taxonomy, decide a PASS/FAIL gate. Real output is the evidence. Use after a Godot slice is implemented, to gate runtime behavior. Do not use to plan a scene (use godot-scene-plan), write or fix code (use implement-approved-slice or implement-slice-complement), triage a failure (use incident-triage), or with no scene to run.
